rows.reason: A combined source baton and failure-dossier display exceeded the bounded presentation surface and was truncated.

rows.reason: The first read-only exact-blob verifier used a stale guessed manifests directory and Git rejected the nonexistent path before evaluating any binding.
rows.recovery: Resolve manifest paths from the exact source tree and rerun only the missing path dependency; 392 exact bindings then passed.

rows.reason: An unquoted PowerShell upstream revision token was parsed as a script block while checking divergence.

rows.reason: A bounded read-only source search used a bare assignment name instead of a PowerShell variable and was rejected.

rows.recovery: Rerun the unchanged official validator once with PYTHONUTF8=1; all ten owner-local skills then returned Skill is valid.

rows.recovery: Correct only the repository-root ancestor, preserve the partial writes, and rerun the idempotent updater.

rows.reason: The second updater attempt encountered the partial first-attempt row under id rather than the Method Flow witness_id key and stopped before projection completion.
rows.recovery: Preserve and normalize the partial row by copying id into witness_id, then rerun the same idempotent projection.
